homeIntro: Wolfish Maia is a lightweight, fast, and powerful command-line assistant for your terminal, built on .NET 10 and powered by local language models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma).

homeFeature1Desc: Built on top of high-performance .NET 10 runtime.
homeFeature2Desc: Interact with Llama, Qwen, and Gemma models directly in your terminal without cloud dependency.
homeFeature3Desc: Quick commands to download dependencies, utilities, and boost your workflow.
